correctness.rationale: Independent exact exhaustion from the stated incidence triples confirms 42 matchings, 18 simple six-cycles, and 72 undirected transitions. Each sign class induces one connected 21-vertex component of diameter four, with three independent degree-six hubs and a low-degree induced union of three six-cycles using the three distinct alternating hub pairs. Testing every matching-pair symmetric difference against the independently generated cycle edge sets implements the stated edge condition exactly. A flip acts by a three-cycle on the assignment permutation; relabeling the parts can interchange sign names but does not alter the equivalence relation. Both supplied checker sources were inspected but not run. No formal certification is asserted.
